mo_ta_cong_viec:
Our client, a leading international Japanese IT solutions provider, is seeking an experienced Senior Fullstack Developer / Tech Lead specializing in AI & GenAI. In this role, you will take part in enterprise-grade software projects, developing, deploying, and maintaining AI-integrated Web and Mobile systems that optimize organizational management and business operations.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and optimize features using Reactjs or Vuejs at the frontend.
Develop backend using Python or Java.
Research and deploy AI/LLM/GenAI solutions into products (Chatbot, AI Agent, RAG, Automation, AI Workflow…).
Participate in requirement analysis and system architecture design.
Optimize system performance, security, and scalability.
Perform effort estimation, assign tasks, conduct code reviews, and mentor junior team members.
Contribute to preparing technical proposals and solution recommendations for clients when required
Work directly with clients/partners.

Must Have:
University or College degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or IT-related fields.
Minimum 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on experience in system architecture design.
Japanese language proficiency (JLPT N2 or above) or basic conversational English skills.
Frontend Development: Practical experience building modern user interfaces using ReactJS or VueJS.
Backend Development: Proficient in server-side development using Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask...), Java (Spring Boot...), or .NET.
Database & Architecture: Solid experience in RESTful API design, database management (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB...), and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) or Microservices architectures.
DevOps Basics: Good working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker containerization.
AI & GenAI Capabilities: Hands-on experience researching, developing, or integrating AI/GenAI solutions (LLMs, Chatbots, RAG, Prompt Engineering, AI Agents, and Workflow Automation).
Soft Skills: Strong logical thinking, structured problem-solving skills, proactive responsibility, and effective team communication.
Language Skill: Good ability to read and understand technical documentation in English.Good to Have:
Knowledge or experience working with Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS).
Practical experience or background in Machine Learning and Deep Learning.
Japanese language proficiency (JLPT N2 or above) or basic conversational English skills.
Prior experience working directly with Japanese corporate clients or stakeholders.
